items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: there was a fellow by the name of Bill Taft Jordan. I remember very well

ctx.x: - that seems to generate with you and certainly when I'm around you it seems to envelop me too. Now getting back to where you were talking about where you were and the great sensation that took over your whole being when your aunt took you to hear the Ringling Brothers Circus band and the bass drum Emil Helmicke played. I just want to ask you, where did you get your first set and what was it like? How did you get into that?

Well, with a series of things but I remember that my aunt bought me this snare drum and I was trying to do other things and everybody in the neighborhood, the kids, in the various one of the last neighborhoods I stayed in, they had come out to play just the snare drum. And throughout that later on in life there was a fellow by the name of Bill Taft Jordan. I remember very well, it can come to me now
